description: This file implements middleware functions for authentication in a Node.js/Express application. It includes functions to extract Bearer tokens from request headers, derive user identity from tokens, load user data from a MongoDB database, and middleware to attach user context to requests or enforce authentication requirements.

methods.name: getBearerToken
methods.description: Extracts the Bearer token from the Authorization header of the request.

methods.name: deriveIdentityFromToken
methods.description: Derives a user identity object from a simple token pattern for demo or stub authentication.

methods.name: loadUserFromDb
methods.description: Loads a user document from the database based on derived identity or headers.

methods.name: attachAuthContext
methods.description: Middleware factory that attaches a user object to the request if a valid Bearer token is present.

methods.name: requireAuth
methods.description: Middleware that enforces authentication by checking for req.user and req.user.id.
